<a id="empirical-scope-of-encounter-control-and-retained-use--经历控制与保留使用的经验范围"></a>
# Empirical scope of encounter control and retained use

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`encounter-control-and-retention` · **reviewed-scoped** · assessment · F09 · [record](encounter-control-and-retention.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Reanalysis of the public CuriGaze inclusion sample, 75 participants and 451 trials, gives Curiosity−Yoked target-looking change of −1.34 percentage points, conventional 95% Welch interval [−10.38,+7.69]. This constrains an automatic selection-to-learning-advantage correspondence.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Use the authors’ cleaned inclusion list joined to trial records, averaging within participants first. Retain the earlier 77-person export as sensitivity; do not select rows to fit a desired finding.
- Conventional t/Welch intervals condition on participant independence. Pair identities are unavailable, sequential-design coverage is unproved, and randomized participant allocation is not established.
- Exploratory secondary analysis after the paper was known. Change in target looking is not proportion of words learned and does not alone identify comprehension, recognized control or a retention mechanism.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- It establishes neither a retention advantage nor equivalence.
- It does not identify a unique psychological mechanism or social cause.
- It does not identify long-term memory, consciousness or evolutionary origin.
- **Counterexample:** Intervals admit positive and negative differences and cannot establish equivalence. Two log-omission reasons and pair mappings are unknown. Raw trajectories are not reprocessed; table-SD discrepancies and singleton multiple-adjustment code are disclosed. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/inquiry-correspondence/contingent-learning/README.md)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Control, effective access, retention and evidence admission are distinct roles within one history. Matched displays do not establish equal retained inputs; a positive pointing comparison does not identify a single social cause across different studies.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>

- **interpretive**: [encounter-selection-and-revision](encounter-selection-and-revision.md). Reuse the completed selection/interpretation interface; later measurement constrains psychological correspondence without a formal conversion of data to Lean histories.
